beats.say: The story starts in eighteen forty-three, when Ada Lovelace saw that Babbage's Analytical Engine could work on symbols, not just on numbers.
The phrase artificial intelligence was named in nineteen fifty-five, and the Dartmouth workshop followed in the summer of nineteen fifty-six.
Deep Blue beat Kasparov in nineteen ninety-seven, AlexNet took off in twenty twelve, and ChatGPT arrived on the thirtieth of November, twenty twenty-two.
